mapper.select: SELECT payment_summary.total_count AS totalCount, payment_summary.success_count AS successCount, CONCAT(FORMAT(payment_summary.success_rate, 2), '%') AS successRate, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(payment_summary.success_amount, 2)) AS successAmount, payment_summary.pending_payment_count AS pendingPaymentCount, payment_summary.closed_payment_count AS closedPaymentCount, COALESCE(refund_summary.failed_refund_count, 0) AS failedRefundCount, COALESCE(channel_summary.disabled_channel_count, 0) AS disabledChannelCount, ( CASE WHEN payment_summary.wait_callback_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN payment_summary.missing_success_time_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN payment_success_fact_summary.mismatch_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(refund_summary.missing_success_time_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN refund_terminal_summary.mismatch_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(refund_summary.failed_refund_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN COALESCE(channel_summary.disabled_channel_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS alertCount FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_count, CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(1) END AS success_rate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PREPAY_CREATED', 'WAIT_CALLBACK') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_payment_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS wait_callback_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing_success_time_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_payment_count FROM t_payment_order ) payment_summary CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS mismatch_count FROM t_payment_order payment_order WHERE payment_order.status = 'SUCCESS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt attempt WHERE attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_payment_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.payment_order_id = payment_order.payment_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND attempt.attempt_status = '成功' AND attempt.completed_at IS NOT NULL ) ) payment_success_fact_summary CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed_refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS missing_success_time_count FROM t_refund_order ) refund_summary CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS mismatch_count FROM t_refund_order refund_order WHERE refund_order.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') AND ( (refund_order.status = 'FAIL' AND refund_order.success_at IS NOT NULL) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_refund_attempt attempt WHERE attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_refund_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.refund_order_id = refund_order.refund_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND attempt.attempt_status = refund_order.status AND attempt.completed_at IS NOT NULL ) ) ) refund_terminal_summary CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS disabled_channel_count FROM t_payment_channel_config WHERE status = 'DISABLED' ) channel_summary

SELECT daily_fact.stat_date AS statDate, SUM(daily_fact.total_count) AS totalCount, SUM(daily_fact.success_count) AS successCount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(daily_fact.success_amount), 0), 2)) AS successAmount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date, COUNT(1) AS total_count, 0 AS success_count, 0 AS success_amount FROM t_payment_order WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL '6' DAY AND created_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL '1' DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(success_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date, 0 AS total_count, COUNT(1) AS success_count, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS success_amount FROM t_payment_order WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL '6' DAY AND success_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL '1' DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(success_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ) daily_fact GROUP BY daily_fact.stat_date ORDER BY statDate DESC LIMIT 7

SELECT channel_code AS channelCode, payment_method AS paymentMethod, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, CONCAT( FORMAT( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(1) END, 2 ), '%' ) AS successRate, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)) AS successAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'P1' WHEN ( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(1) END ) < 80 THEN 'P2' ELSE '正常' END AS riskLevel, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'danger' WHEN ( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(1) END ) < 80 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'success' END AS riskLevelType, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '存在待收口支付单，建议优先查单并核对回调。' WHEN ( CASE WHEN COUNT(1) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(1) END ) < 80 THEN '成功率偏低，建议检查路由命中、渠道稳定性和异常日志。' ELSE '当前渠道表现稳定，可持续观察。' END AS riskHint FROM t_payment_order WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt WHERE t_payment_attempt.payment_order_id = t_payment_order.payment_order_id ) GROUP BY channel_code, payment_method ORDER BY totalCount DESC, successCount DESC, channel_code ASC, payment_method ASC

SELECT 1 AS alertSortNo, 'WAIT_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT' AS alertType, '支付回调待收口' AS alertTitle, '仍有支付单处于待回调状态，需要主动查单或补回调。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入支付交易异常中心，优先核对待回调支付单、回调日志和查单结果。' AS suggestedAction, '/payment-issues?issueType=待回调未收口' AS actionRoute FROM t_payment_order WHERE status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS alertSortNo, 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS_TIME_MISSING' AS alertType, '支付成功时间缺失' AS alertTitle, '存在已成功但缺少成功时间的支付单，无法可信归属支付账期。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入支付单管理页核对成功时间缺失记录。' AS suggestedAction, '/payments?status=SUCCESS_TIME_MISSING' AS actionRoute FROM t_payment_order WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS alertSortNo, 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS_FACT_MISMATCH' AS alertType, '支付成功事实不一致' AS alertTitle, '存在支付单成功终态与最新支付尝试状态不一致或完成事实缺失的记录。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入支付单管理页核对支付单、最新尝试和操作日志。' AS suggestedAction, '/payments?status=SUCCESS_FACT_MISMATCH' AS actionRoute FROM t_payment_order payment_order WHERE payment_order.status = 'SUCCESS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt attempt WHERE attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_payment_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.payment_order_id = payment_order.payment_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND attempt.attempt_status = '成功' AND attempt.completed_at IS NOT NULL ) HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 4 AS alertSortNo, 'REFUND_SUCCESS_TIME_MISSING' AS alertType, '退款成功时间缺失' AS alertTitle, '存在已成功但缺少成功时间的退款单，无法可信归属逆向资金账期。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入退款单管理页核对成功时间缺失记录。' AS suggestedAction, '/refunds?refundStatus=SUCCESS_TIME_MISSING' AS actionRoute FROM t_refund_order WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND success_at IS NULL HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 5 AS alertSortNo, 'REFUND_TERMINAL_FACT_MISMATCH' AS alertType, '退款终态事实不一致' AS alertTitle, '存在退款单终态与最新退款尝试状态不一致或完成事实缺失的记录。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入退款单管理页核对退款单、最新尝试和操作日志。' AS suggestedAction, '/refunds?refundStatus=TERMINAL_FACT_MISMATCH' AS actionRoute FROM t_refund_order refund_order WHERE refund_order.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAIL') AND ( (refund_order.status = 'FAIL' AND refund_order.success_at IS NOT NULL) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_refund_attempt attempt WHERE attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_refund_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.refund_order_id = refund_order.refund_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND attempt.attempt_status = refund_order.status AND attempt.completed_at IS NOT NULL ) ) HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 6 AS alertSortNo, 'REFUND_FAIL' AS alertType, '退款失败待重试' AS alertTitle, '退款单存在失败记录，需要运营复核后重试或切线下处理。' AS alertMessage, 'P1' AS alertLevel, 'danger' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入退款单管理页，按失败状态过滤后复核重试。' AS suggestedAction, '/refunds?refundStatus=FAIL' AS actionRoute FROM t_refund_order WHERE status = 'FAIL' HAVING COUNT(1) > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 7 AS alertSortNo, 'CHANNEL_DISABLED' AS alertType, '渠道已停用' AS alertTitle, '存在已停用渠道，请确认是否需要同步调整路由规则。' AS alertMessage, 'P2' AS alertLevel, 'warn' AS alertLevelType, COUNT(1) AS affectedCount, '进入支付渠道与路由页，检查停用渠道和对应路由规则。' AS suggestedAction, '/payment-config?channelStatus=DISABLED' AS actionRoute FROM t_payment_channel_config WHERE status = 'DISABLED' HAVING COUNT(1) > 0 ORDER BY alertSortNo ASC
